name: actual-egg-timer
description: Actual Egg Timer: a boiled-egg timer that computes the time from transient conduction and denaturation kinetics

scripts.fixtures:check: npm run fixtures && git diff --exit-code -- fixtures/ && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- fixtures/)"
scripts.conformance: npm run fixtures:check && cd ios/EggTimerCore && swift test
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run copy:literals && npm run fixtures:check && cd ios/EggTimerCore && swift test
scripts.ios:build: cd ios && xcodegen --quiet && xcodebuild -project ActualEggTimer.xcodeproj -scheme ActualEggTimer -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet build
scripts.build:site: rm -rf _site && tsc -p tsconfig.site.json && cp index.html styles.css site.webmanifest _site/ && node tools/sitePaths.mjs && rm -rf _site/assets _site/copy _site/privacy && cp -R assets _site/assets && cp -R copy _site/copy && cp -R privacy _site/privacy && mkdir -p _site/fixtures && cp fixtures/population.json _site/fixtures/population.json && node tools/precache.mjs
scripts.serve:dev: npm run build:site && tsc && node dist/tools/devServer.js
scripts.e2e: npm run build:site && tsc && node dist/tools/e2e.js
